dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association. GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL target typical of ORCA project.
evidence: no EXEC CICS/SQL, fixed format, COPY count 21, CALL count 28

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing system (receipt/claim processing) - inpatient accounting sub-module for the JMA ORCA system. Handles hospitalization fee calculation including special admission fees, meal management, nursing care additions, etc.
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that handles inpatient (nyuin) accounting data retrieval and calculation. It processes hospitalization fee components including various addition/deduction rules for Japanese medical insurance billing, meal management fees, and special care additions. It is called as part of the receipt claim generation workflow.

notable_features: Large working-storage with many OCCURS tables for daily hospitalization tracking (up to 31 days)
21 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
28 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
348 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - file-based batch processing
REDEFINES usage for code/numeric dual access
Detailed revision history in comments (versions 01.00.01 through 01.00.12)
Multiple specialized work tables for food/meal fee calculations (WRK-SKJ series)
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 246190 bytes (5026 lines total), so only DATA DIVISION working-storage is visible in the excerpt; PROCEDURE DIVISION not shown but confirmed present per mechanical indicators.
